sections.title: ⚠️ REALITY CHECK
sections.content: AI is prone to 'condong' (outdated) knowledge. **The Death Loop:** If AI apologizes twice for the same error, STOP. Open a fresh chat.

sections.title: 🗺️ THE BIG PICTURE
sections.content:
**Global View:** Automate JWT & Social Login wiring.
**Motivation:** Auth is painful. Do this once, never do it manually again.

sections.title: 🛠️ THE SETUP
sections.content:
- Node.js v18+
- Local throwaway DB keys
- MCP Server for context

sections.title: 🛡️ GUARDRAILS
sections.content: Run `terraform plan` or `Prisma diff`. Do not deploy if you see unexpected DB drops.

sections.title: 🚨 INCIDENT: AUTH DEATH LOOP
sections.content:
**Issue:** AI kept using `express-session` when I asked for JWT.
**Fix:** Clear context and explicitly say: 'Do not use sessions, only Stateless JWT'.
